## Description

Gng Sng, Co-Founder and CTO of Cogent Security, breaks down how they approach defense in depth for AI agents. Their sandboxes run with read-only permissions by default, a policy engine handles access elevation, and any write action happens outside the box — fully secure and deterministic. The rule: agents should never be able to do something the system is disallowing.

This clip is from Max Agency, a #podcast about how the best AI agents are actually being built. Hosted by Harrison Chase, CEO of LangChain, each episode goes deep with the builders designing, deploying, and learning from real agent systems in the wild. From architecture decisions to evals, tooling, and failure modes, Max Agency is for people who want to understand what it really takes to build useful agents.

#AIAgents #AISecurity

## Description

Securing Real-Time Communication: Porting and running Edge Computing for mission critical services on Morello CHERI

UM Labs is a UK R&D company specialising in cybersecurity for Real-Time Communication. This includes voice and video calls, streaming video, augmented reality and IoT. Our Unicus® platform implements a Core/Edge architecture with Core running in a public or private cloud and Edge protecting end point devices such as cameras, AR devices or IoT sensors and actuators. Unicus Edge may be integrated with an end-point device or operate on a small-scale system protecting multiple devices. Edge and Core share a common architecture with layered security providing full-stack protection. Edge systems are provisioned by Core with all communication between Edge and Core authenticated and encrypted. Encryption options include the use of Post Quantum Cryptography (PQC) algorithms.

Unicus is widely installed in government, defence and commercial networks through our partnerships with BT, KPN and with Atos.

## Description

As AI agents become deeply integrated into the enterprise, traditional security measures are reaching an inflection point. In this premiere research briefing, Lawrence Pingree (Head of Data & AI Security at SACR and former Gartner analyst) breaks down the emerging category of UADP and why intent-aware security is the new standard for 2026.

In this video, you will learn:
- The Definition of Agentics: The difference between the AI Agent (the software) and Agentics (the reasoning mind).
- New Attack Surfaces: Why LLMs and autonomous agents require runtime expansion and behavioral analysis.
- The Majestic Technoscope: A unique matrix ranking of the top vendors in the UADP space, including Palo Alto Networks, SentinelOne, Microsoft, and Cyera.
- Regulatory Landscapes: How Executive Orders, NIST, and the EU Cyber Resilience Act are forcing a shift in AI governance.
- Proactive vs. Reactive: Why we must move toward Just-In-Time (JIT) trust and machine-speed autonomous response.
